description: Wikipedia pageviews trend for any topic: interest over time as a measure of topic popularity and public attention. Free text (brand, person, product, event) is resolved to the matching Wikipedia article. Returns daily views normalized 0-100, 7-day and window % change, direction (rising, falling, stable, spiking), peak day and spike detection. Similar in purpose to Google Trends search interest, but it measures Wikipedia reading, not searches. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

days.description: Window length in days, ending yesterday UTC (default 30)

topic.description: Free-text topic resolved to the best-matching Wikipedia article, e.g. 'bitcoin', 'Taylor Swift', 'AI Act'

name: wikipedia_pageviews_trend
title: Wikipedia Pageviews Trend
